Initial release of self-improving-life: a holistic system for life satisfaction and balance tracking.

- Provides structured assessment across six key life domains (health, relationships, career, finances, growth, leisure)
- Introduces monthly Life Wheel Assessments, daily logs, and transition logs for systematic, evidence-based self-improvement
- Includes clear metrics, ideal time allocations, and adjustment suggestions for each domain
- Offers practical workflow samples and detailed logging formats for long-term tracking and reflection
